clauses.requirement: Every device of an approved type (rear lamp incorporating the retro-reflective device) shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and the other markings defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2, or alternatively for the approval marking and the other markings defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
All markings on the device shall be clearly legible and indelible.
The size of the approval marking shall conform to the value of "a" defined in Table 1; the arrangement of the markings shall be consistent with the examples shown in Annex 10.
The approval marking of the device shall consist of the elements specified in paragraphs 3.3.2.1 to 3.3.2.4.
The approval marking shall include the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted the approval.

The approval marking shall include the four to six-digit sequential number that is part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2, and this sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
The approval marking shall include the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device as prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.

The approval marking shall include the number of this Regulation (UN R150) followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
